entities.name: Ulaten
entities.description: Member of the Weatherlight's cockpit crew under Shanna, known for lightening stressful situations with humor; later transformed by Phyrexian corruption.

entities.name: Shanna
entities.description: Leader of the Weatherlight's crew who confronted the corrupted Ulaten.

entities.name: Tiana
entities.description: Ventured with Shanna into the corrupted Weatherlight.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: Skyship that was overrun by Phyrexian corruption and compleated.

events.summary: During the Phyrexian attack on the Weatherlight, Ulaten was severely injured.
events.quote: Ulaten was among those who were severely injured.

events.summary: Shanna and Tiana found Ulaten's head incorporated into a Phyrexian tentacle-like appendage in the corrupted Weatherlight.
events.quote: they found Ulaten’s head incorporated into a Phyrexian tentacle-like appendage

events.summary: Shanna severed Ulaten's tentacle, ending his suffering.
events.quote: Shanna confronted this abomination and severed Ulaten’s tentacle, ending his suffering and releasing his spirit from the torment.

relations.quote: Ulaten was one of Shanna 's crew on the Skyship Weatherlight prior to its Compleation
